$comment: A .lips file: a TypeScript script, then the template. Mirrors parseSFC / findTemplateStart in @lipsjs/lips: the template starts at the first '<' that opens a line (after any indentation) and is followed by [A-Za-z{>!], at the script's top level; a file that opens that way has no script. Top level is where TypeScript's own rules are all closed: inside a string, a comment or brackets, the end below is never tried.
name: Lips
